subject: Re: AcmeEdge onboarding — request for invoice-only pilot (no-PO)
thread_summary: Vendor requested an invoice-only onboarding path for a short pilot; procurement evaluated risk and manager approved a 30-day invoice-only exception with conditions.
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <contracts@acmeedge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AcmeEdge onboarding — request for invoice-only pilot (no PO)

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get the pilot started. A quick ask from our side: for this initial 30-day pilot (estimated spend ~$8k) AcmeEdge typically goes through invoice-only intake rather than issuing a PO due to our small pilot process.

I've attached our completed onboarding form and the SOW for the pilot. Can Redwood accept invoices to the following billing address and net-30?

AcmeEdge
AP: payables@acmeedge.com
Billing address: 123 Foundry Way, Suite 400, Portland, OR

If a PO is required, we can loop our procurement team but that will add several days. For the pilot timeline we'd appreciate an invoice-only path if procurement can sign off on a temporary exception.

Attachments: AcmeEdge_Onboarding_Form.pdf, SOW_AcmeEdge_Pilot_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Jordan Mills
Head of Partnerships
AcmeEdge
contracts@acmeedge.com

Marcus/Priya — looping you in on a vendor onboarding ask. AcmeEdge wants an invoice-only path for a 30-day pilot (~$8k) to avoid PO procurement delays. They attached the onboarding form and SOW (see below).

Can procurement review for a short-term exception? Key questions:
- Is this level of spend OK for invoice-only per policy?
- Any specific controls or paperwork we should require (e.g., SOC2 cert, insurance, payment contact)?
- If we approve, can procurement create a temporary vendor record and flag it as "pilot — invoice-only"?

Priya — can you own evidence collection (SOC2, W9 if needed)? Marcus — can you advise on the approval path? Laura, FYI — this is time-sensitive for the pilot kickoff Wed.

Thanks,
Mina

Subject: RE: Fwd: AcmeEdge onboarding — request for invoice-only pilot (no PO)

Thanks for the context, Mina. Quick procurement stance and proposed controls: 

1) Policy baseline: Our standard policy requires a PO for new vendors unless spend is under the small-dollar threshold ($5k) or the vendor is on the pre-approved invoice-only allowlist. This pilot (~$8k) is above the small-dollar threshold, so it normally requires a PO.

2) Proposed exception for pilot: Given the timeline and strategic fit, procurement can approve a 30-day invoice-only exception under the following conditions:
  - Redline of SOW accepted (we asked legal to confirm minimal redlines)
  - AcmeEdge provides SOC2 Type II (or equivalent evidence) and W9/Tax form
  - Finance confirms net-30 payment terms and AP contact
  - Redwood flags vendor record as "pilot: invoice-only" with expiration date (30 days from approval)
  - Spend ceiling set at $10,000 for the pilot

3) Risks & mitigation: Invoice-only increases fraud and duplicate vendor risk. We mitigate by strictly limiting duration, requiring SOC2, and A/P review of invoices before payment.

Next steps I need from Mina: upload vendor docs to secure drive (Priya will own collection), confirm SOW redline requests to Legal, and I'll raise PROC-1247 to track the exception. If Laura signs off, we can proceed this week.

Marcus
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: AcmeEdge onboarding — request for invoice-only pilot (no PO)

Thanks team — I approve a one-time, 30-day invoice-only exception for AcmeEdge under the controls Marcus listed. A few clarifying points before this moves forward: 

- Exception window: 30 days from the date procurement flags the vendor record (not from the pilot start).
- Reporting: Revenue/CS should track usage and notify Procurement/Legal 5 days before expiration if we want to convert to full PO on ongoing terms.
- Finance holdback: Finance can hold net payment on first invoice up to 7 days for verification; inform the customer.
- Escalation: If vendor fails to produce required evidence (SOC2/W9) within 72 hours, exception is revoked immediately.

Mina — please confirm you have vendor's SOC2 and W9 uploaded to the secure folder and add the AcmeEdge vendor record to PROC-1247. Priya, Marcus — please confirm once vendor is flagged in the vendor registry.

I'll copy Legal if there are material redlines to the SOW; otherwise proceed.

Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts (acting)
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
